mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_event (user_id, start_date, end_date, event_time, title, memo, color_tag, is_hidden) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dto.startDate}, #{dto.endDate}, #{dto.time}, #{dto.title}, #{dto.memo}, #{dto.colorTag}, #{dto.hidden})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_event SET start_date = #{dto.startDate}, end_date = #{dto.endDate}, event_time = #{dto.time}, title = #{dto.title}, memo = #{dto.memo}, color_tag = #{dto.colorTag}, is_hidden = #{dto.hidden} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM schedule_event WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
